narrative:
## Financial Statements — Plan Submission Summary

3-statement model validated and approved by Khalid Al-Rashid, Executive VP & Chief Financial Officer. All versions (FY2025 Actuals, FY2026 Budget, FY2026 Q3 Forecast, FY2024 Actuals) reconciled.

## Key Metrics
• Revenue: USD 480.0B actuals / USD 492.2B budget / USD 472.9B Q3 forecast
• EBITDA margin: 43.5% actuals / 43.6% budget
• Free cash flow: USD 58.6B actuals / USD 60.3B budget
• Balance sheet: assets = liabilities + equity

signals.title: Q3 forecast $19B below the $492B budget
signals.excerpt: Lower realized prices across the chain drive the gap: crude fields −$8.3B, refining −$7.2B, gas −$1.2B and trading −$2.7B; volumes are broadly on plan.
